input.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(i.category1, '(eslesmeyen/NULL)') AS category1,
       ROUND(SUM(m.revenue), 2) AS toplam_ciro_tl,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m.revenue) / SUM(SUM(m.revenue)) OVER (), 2) AS pay_yuzde,
       MIN(m.month) AS ilk_ay, MAX(m.month) AS son_ay
FROM monthly_item_sales m
LEFT JOIN items i ON i.item_id = m.item_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY toplam_ciro_tl DESC
SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue),2) AS toplam_ciro_tl, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS ay_sayisi FROM monthly_item_sales
